metadata.title: Nvidia Stock Has Been a Chip Stock Outperformer in July. Why Its Rally Is at Risk.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia Stock Has Been a Chip Stock Outperformer in July. Why Its Rally Is at Risk.
Nvidia stock has been a rare July winner for chip stocks, but as shares slip again on Friday—even as Intel and AMD—rise, that outperformance could be at risk.
